name: Lower Moreland Summer Recreation
description_short: Six week morning recreation program for Lower Moreland Township children who have finished grades 1 to 6, run 9:00 to 1:00 at Murray Avenue School. Each week has a theme with planned activities and field trips to local activity centers; only township children can enroll.

sessions.name: Summer program, Monday to Friday 9:00 to 1:00

notes: 2026: $375 per child for the summer, trips included; $25 a day guest fee. Open to Lower Moreland Township children only; register by mail or in person at the Municipal Building, 640 Red Lion Road, from April 2, 2026. Parents provide transportation to and from the school. Children bring a snack or light lunch. The page lists no camp on July 4, 2026, a Saturday. 2027 not yet posted.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Recreation 2026 page: township children who completed grades 1 to 6 in 2025/26 (stored as grades 2 to 7 in the fall; ages derived from grades, not stated); June 22 to July 31, 9 to 1, Murray Avenue School; $375 per child; parents provide transportation; gym floor and outdoor activities; no refunds. Phone is the township office.

for_andrew: Residents only: the page is for Lower Moreland Township children, with one fee of $375 for the six weeks. I recorded that rate and said who can enroll in the description. It is a 9 to 1 morning program, and Huntingdon Valley is outside the named towns (borders Abington). List it?
